name: THE DAY IS AT HAND
text: This turning point, an operative whose order flips from Conceal to Engage when it is activated fights dirty until that activation ends: Rending on its ranged weapons and one extra attack die (5 at most) on its melee weapons.

name: CROSSFIRE
text: This turning point, a Wyrmblade shooting an enemy that a different Wyrmblade has already shot this turning point gains Accurate 1 on its ranged weapons.

name: ONE WITH THE SHADOWS
text: This turning point, a Conceal Wyrmblade that is shot counts as obscured behind intervening Light terrain, unless that terrain lies within 1 inch of the shooter or the target.

name: DIVERT AND DISAPPEAR
text: Shuffle up to three Wyrmblade operatives in turn: each takes a free Dash or a free Charge capped at 3 inches. A Cult Agent uses two of the three places and may take a free 3-inch Fall Back instead, at the price of -1 APL until its next activation ends.

name: SLINK INTO DARKNESS
text: When a Wyrmblade operative's activation ends on an Engage order, flip it to Conceal. Each operative can be the subject only once per battle.

name: COILED SERPENT
text: In the first Shoot or Fight of an activation that began with a Conceal-to-Engage switch, after your attack dice are rolled, upgrade one normal success to a critical. Once per activation.

name: UNQUESTIONING LOYALTY
text: When a Cult Agent or the Leader is picked as a Shoot target or Fight opponent, a different Neophyte (not the Leader) within 3 inches that it can see throws itself in the way and takes its place, valid or not. In a Fight the stand-in counts as within the attacker's control range; in a Shoot it is in cover or obscured only if the original target was. Useless against Blast and Torrent.

name: A PLAN GENERATIONS IN THE MAKING
text: A Neophyte that is incapacitated may carry out one free mission action before it is removed.
